cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. The NHRC's 2024 report says the system has e-filing, but not that anyone files through it.
cells.note: The electronic case management system was in pilot in August 2024 (GMB-005), the Chief Justice still awaited its implementation in January 2026 (GMB-002), and a tender to build an integrated system followed in March 2026 (GMB-001). It is piloted, not in service, so stage 2; the e-filing the NHRC names (GMB-004) cannot count above that.
